def _change_intake(inv: Invocation, transition: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from management_portal.lineage_service import resident_intake_domain

    target_state = "open" if transition == "open" else "closed"
    # Human or Resident callers change intake by hand; manual opening also
    # records a manual release of the account's quota guard.
    manual = inv.entry != "lineage"
    if inv.argument("account_id"):
        change = (
            resident_intake_domain.open_account_residents
            if transition == "open"
            else resident_intake_domain.close_account_residents
        )
        result = change(inv.argument("account_id"), inv.caller)
        changed_key = "reopened" if transition == "open" else "closed"
        return {
            **result,
            "changed_resident_ids": list(result.get(changed_key) or []),
            "unchanged_resident_ids": list(result.get("skipped") or []),
            "failed": list(result.get("errors") or []),
        }
    single = inv.argument("resident_id")
    targets = [single] if single else [str(item).strip().lower() for item in inv.argument("resident_ids") or []]
    changed: list[str] = []
    unchanged: list[str] = []
    failed: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    last: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for resident_id in targets:
        try:
            previous = _intake_state(resident_id, inv.caller)
            # A manual Close still runs on a closed Resident: it turns a closure made
            # by the quota guard into a manual one, so quota recovery keeps it closed.
            if previous == target_state and not (manual and transition == "close"):
                unchanged.append(resident_id)
                last = {"previous": previous, "current": previous, "changed": False}
                continue
            lineage_id = lineage_of_resident(resident_id)
            result = domain().change_lineage_resident_state(
                lineage_id,
                {"resident_id": resident_id, "state_domain": "intake", "transition": transition},
                inv.caller,
                allow_quota_override=manual,
            )
            # The transition returns the committed intake state; no second Resident
            # projection is needed merely to classify the result.
            current = str(result.get("intake_state") or result.get("state") or "")
            (changed if previous != current else unchanged).append(resident_id)
            last = {"previous": previous, "current": current, "changed": previous != current, "state": result}
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - one Resident failing does not stop the batch
            if single:
                raise
            failed.append({"resident_id": resident_id, "error": str(exc) or type(exc).__name__})
    if single:
        return last
    return {
        "changed_resident_ids": changed,
        "unchanged_resident_ids": unchanged,
        "failed": failed,
        "changed_count": len(changed),
        "unchanged_count": len(unchanged),
        "failed_count": len(failed),
    }

def emit_manual_event(
    lineage_id: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    actor: str,
    *,
    authority: ProgramControlAuthority,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Trigger one ``manual.triggered`` Event Source, or only one of its wires."""
    _lineage_scope = authority.lineage_scope
    _read_lineage = authority.read_lineage
    _ensure_manager = authority.ensure_manager
    dispatch_lineage_program_event = authority.dispatch_lineage_program_event
    observe_trigger_path = authority.observe_trigger_path
    get_lineage = authority.get_lineage

    actor_id = _safe_actor(actor)
    event_source_id = _text(payload.get("event_source_id"), 110).lower()
    wire_id = _text(payload.get("wire_id"), 110).lower()
    if not event_source_id and not wire_id:
        raise ValueError("触发 Event 必须指定 Event Source 或连线")
    with _lineage_scope(lineage_id):
        lineage = _read_lineage(lineage_id, actor=actor)
        _ensure_manager(lineage, actor_id)
        plan = _compiled_program(lineage)
        if wire_id:
            wire = next(
                (item for item in plan.get("wires") or [] if str(item.get("id") or "") == wire_id),
                None,
            )
            if not wire or str(wire.get("kind") or "") != "route":
                raise KeyError("Event 连线不存在")
            wire_source = str(wire.get("source") or "")
            if event_source_id and event_source_id != wire_source:
                raise ValueError("连线不属于这个 Event Source")
            event_source_id = wire_source
        event_source = (plan.get("event_sources") or {}).get(event_source_id)
        if not isinstance(event_source, dict) or event_source.get("kind") != "event_source":
            raise KeyError("program Event Source not found")
        if str(event_source.get("event_type") or "") != "manual.triggered":
            raise ValueError("TriggerEvent 只能触发 manual.triggered 事件源")
        source_contract = _program_event_source_contract_fingerprint(event_source)
        occurrence = secrets.token_hex(12)
        event_payload: dict[str, Any] = {"triggered_by": actor_id, "prompt": payload.get("prompt")}
        if "content_parts" in payload:
            event_payload["content_parts"] = payload["content_parts"]
        if wire_id:
            event_payload["edge_id"] = wire_id
        if payload.get("event_name"):
            event_payload["name"] = payload["event_name"]
        if isinstance(payload.get("payload"), dict):
            event_payload["data"] = payload["payload"]
        from management_portal.hatg.kernel import current_instruction_id
        instruction = current_instruction_id()
        event_payload["cause"] = ({"kind": "instruction", "id": instruction} if instruction
                                  else {"kind": "input", "id": occurrence})
        event = lineage_primitives.make_event(
            "manual.triggered",
            subject_resident_id=_text(payload.get("subject_resident_id"), 80).lower(),
            payload=event_payload,
            correlation=f"{event_source_id}:{occurrence}",
        )
    dispatched = dispatch_lineage_program_event(
        lineage_id,
        event_source_id,
        event,
        actor_id,
        cursor=f"manual:{occurrence}",
        expected_event_source_contract=source_contract,
        **({"selected_wire_ids": {wire_id}} if wire_id else {}),
    )
    if dispatched.get("paused"):
        raise EventSourcePausedError("事件源已暂停，恢复后才能触发")

def normalize_error(exc: BaseException) -> InstructionError:
    """Map a domain exception to the instruction error vocabulary."""

    code_by_exception = (
        (PermissionError, "instruction.forbidden"),
        (FileNotFoundError, "instruction.not_found"),
        (KeyError, "instruction.not_found"),
        (FileExistsError, "instruction.conflict"),
        (ValueError, "instruction.invalid_arguments"),
    )
    if isinstance(exc, OperationError):
        failure = exc.failure_payload()
        code = str(failure["code"])

def familize(lineage_id: str, resident_ids: Iterable[str], actor: str, *, title: str = "", goal: str = "",
             parameters: Mapping | None = None, placement_request: dict | None = None,
             resident_settings: Mapping | None = None, template_id: str = TEMPLATE_ID, scope: str = "selection",
             personal_ama_id: str = "") -> dict:
    from .. import function_block_domain
    lineage = _read(lineage_id, actor)
    if scope not in {"selection", "lineage"}:
        raise TemplateError("Family scope 必须是 selection 或 lineage")
    if scope == "lineage":
        if resident_ids:
            raise TemplateError("整条 Lineage Familize 不接受 resident_ids")
        existing = facts.lineage_family(lineage)
        if existing:
            family = existing["family"]
            return result("Lineage 已有 Family", family_id=existing["id"], resource_id=family["resource_id"], function_block_ids=[existing["id"]],
                **{role + "_resident_id": family[role] for role in ("facade", "steward", "router")},
                member_resident_ids=family["members"], leader_resident_id=lineage.get("leader_resident_id", ""),
                rewired_wire_ids=[])
        resident_ids = facts.lineage_members(lineage)
    members = facts.validate_members(lineage, _selection(lineage, resident_ids))
    if personal_ama_id and (lineage.get("lineage_membership") != "personal" or members != [personal_ama_id]):
        raise TemplateError("个人助手只以当前 AMA 为初始成员")
    if not members and scope != "lineage":
        raise TemplateError("Familize 至少需要 1 个 Resident")
    values = _values({**dict(parameters or {}), **({"goal": goal} if goal else {})})
    settings = _resident_settings(resident_settings)
    title = str(title or lineage.get("title") or "Family").strip()
    element_keys = _member_elements(lineage, members, lineage_scope=scope == "lineage")
    # Validate ownership and nesting before creating any roles.
    if element_keys:
        function_block_domain.functionalize_in_body(copy.deepcopy(lineage), list(element_keys), actor, title=title)
    placement = dict(placement_request or {})
    near = str(placement.get("near_resident_id") or _central_member(lineage, members))
    roles = {role: _new_role(lineage_id, role, title, actor, near, settings, placement,
                           creation_key=f"personal-assistant:{personal_ama_id}:{role}" if personal_ama_id else "")
             for role in ("facade", "steward", "router")}
    leader = str(lineage.get("leader_resident_id") or "")
    from .. import identity_contract
    family = {"resource_id": identity_contract.new_id("family"), "title": title, **values, **roles, "members": members, "lineage_scope": scope == "lineage",
              "previous_leader_id": leader if leader in members else "",
              "human_familizer_id": canonical_actor_id(actor) if actor_principal(actor).kind == "user" else ""}
    if personal_ama_id:
        from .. import resident_conversation_stream
        from ..lineage_primitives import now_iso
        page = resident_conversation_stream.get_repository().agent_data.read_chat_message_page(personal_ama_id, limit=1)
        family.update(personal_ama_id=personal_ama_id, history_before=now_iso(),
                      history_before_ordinal=(page.get("ordinals") or [0])[-1] + 1)

    def edit(body):
        facts.validate_members(body, members)
        keys = {**_member_elements(body, members, lineage_scope=scope == "lineage"),
                **{rid: role + "_resident" for role, rid in roles.items()}}
        block = function_block_domain.functionalize_in_body(body, list(keys), actor, title=title,
                    template_id=template_id, element_keys=keys, x=placement.get("x"), y=placement.get("y"))
        block["family"] = copy.deepcopy(family)
        family_workflows.update(body, block, actor, collect=True)
        reconcile_in_body(body, block, actor)
        if leader in members or scope == "lineage" or personal_ama_id:
            body["leader_resident_id"] = roles["facade"]
        return {"family_id": block["id"], "rewired_wire_ids": _rewire(body, set(members), roles["facade"], block)}

    view, outcome = _domain().commit_lineage_edit(lineage_id, actor, edit, reason="Familize：创建 Family")
    block = _block(view, outcome["family_id"])
    from ..personal_assistant import steward_rules
    family_facade.tell_steward(roles["facade"], roles["steward"], actor, steward_rules(family, block["id"]) if personal_ama_id else charter(
        title=title, goal=values["goal"], facade_id=roles["facade"], router_id=roles["router"],
        members=[{"resident_id": rid, "title": str(facts._find(rid).get("title") or "")} for rid in members],
        threshold=values["route_threshold"], family_id=block["id"]))
    return result(f"已创建 Family「{title}」", **outcome, resource_id=block["family"]["resource_id"], function_block_ids=[block["id"]],
        facade_resident_id=roles["facade"], steward_resident_id=roles["steward"], router_resident_id=roles["router"],
        member_resident_ids=members, leader_resident_id=view.get("leader_resident_id", ""),
        created={"resident_ids": list(roles.values()),
